CivicRecord.title: CivicRecord
CivicRecord.description: Publicly readable civic transparency record override or addition managed by verified administrators across BetterAlcala categories.

recordId.description: Unique identifier matching the document ID.

category.description: Module category of the civic record.

title.description: Human-readable title or name of the civic record.

verificationNotes.description: Editorial verification rationale or citation note.

isBaselineOverride.description: True when overriding or suppressing a static baseline record.

isDeleted.description: True when an admin has removed a baseline record from public views.

payload.description: Structured category-specific fields stored as a native Firestore map.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the authenticated admin who last modified this record.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized BetterAlcala administrator profile (isolated from public reads for PII protection).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

ConnectionProbe.title: ConnectionProbe
ConnectionProbe.description: Read-only health probe document for verifying Firestore connectivity at startup.

/civic_records/{recordId}.description: Publicly readable civic transparency overrides and admin-managed records across all 13 categories.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Restricted list of authorized BetterAlcala administrators.
